about: The README's tool gallery is generated from this map by scripts/readme-blocks.py (D00 T05 §2). Each row names its icon and the plan that owns its C++ build; the generator refuses a tool the tree has that this map lacks. A folded tool names what it folds into, from the product decisions in docs/brainstorm/2026-09-16-completion-brainstorm.md (decision 6). Re-pointed at D06 T01 §10's registry once that ships.

tools.name: Ownership
tools.job: Take ownership of files, folders and registry keys from the context menu.

tools.name: ComIntRep
tools.job: Repair Windows internet and network connectivity in one pass: Winsock, IP, proxy and more.

tools.name: PixRepair
tools.job: Exercise stuck LCD pixels with rapidly changing colour patterns.

tools.name: BiosCodes
tools.job: Look up what a BIOS beep code means, by manufacturer.

tools.name: USBRepair
tools.job: Repair USB devices and drives that Windows no longer recognises.

tools.name: DVDRepair
tools.job: Repair CD and DVD drives that Windows no longer shows.

tools.name: MemBoost
tools.job: Free physical memory by trimming the working sets of running processes.

tools.name: Firemin
tools.job: Keep Firefox's memory use in check while it runs.

tools.name: Chromin
tools.job: Keep Chrome's memory use in check while it runs.

tools.name: Edgemin
tools.job: Keep Microsoft Edge's memory use in check while it runs.

tools.name: Watermin
tools.job: Keep Waterfox's memory use in check while it runs.

tools.name: RegStudio
tools.job: Browse, search and edit the Windows registry, with every change reversible.
